meta.source: docs/BRAND.md (DEC-027 to DEC-052, DEC-075 to DEC-084) and apps/web/src/app/globals.css at 2bb00cf; semantic layer and scales by lane D

tokens.name: zed
tokens.usage: Brand. The ground for the header, the Wall hero, Ones pages, the office screen and the launch. Text on white (19.8:1).

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Brand. The page for working screens; text on Zed. Kept as pure white because the brand fixes it (DEC-028).

tokens.name: electric
tokens.usage: Brand. ONLY things you can press: buttons, links, focus rings, a selected choice. White on it 5.2:1; on white 5.2:1; on Zed only at 24 px and up (3.8:1).

tokens.name: electric-deep
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of Electric. White on it 7.2:1.

tokens.name: spark
tokens.usage: Brand. The outlier: once per screen, only on the one (the mark's spark, a One's spark or number at Tier 1). 6.4:1 on Zed. Never text on white, never on Electric.

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces on Zed; the paused-feature band on every surface.

tokens.name: coal
tokens.usage: Hover and second raise on Zed. Ash on it 6.3:1.

tokens.name: ash
tokens.usage: Secondary text on Zed (7.8:1) and Graphite (7.0:1). Never on white.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Secondary text on white (6.1:1) and Paper (5.6:1).

tokens.name: steel
tokens.usage: Control borders: inputs, unchecked boxes, empty slashes. 4.6:1 on white, 4.3:1 on Zed (needs 3:1).

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The second neutral layer on white: panels, idea cards, table heads. Zed on it 18.1:1, Electric 4.8:1.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Hover on white rows and panels.

tokens.name: line-light
tokens.usage: Decorative borders on white (dividers, card edges). Never a control's only boundary.

tokens.name: line-dark
tokens.usage: Decorative borders on Zed.

tokens.name: link-on-zed
tokens.usage: Links and focus rings on Zed and Graphite, where Electric is too dark for text (7.5:1 on Zed). Same as the emails' dark links.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The page ground of the current surface.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels, cards and table heads on the current surface. Elevation is lightness, not shadow.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on rows, cards and quiet buttons.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings. 19.8:1 either way round.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Hints, 'Why we ask', meta. 6.1:1 on white, 7.8:1 on Zed.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and card edges.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes, radios, empty slashes. Passes 3:1 on both surfaces.

tokens.name: press
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary button; border of a secondary button; a selected choice.

tokens.name: press-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover and active.

tokens.name: press-ink
tokens.usage: Text on a pressable fill.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Text links and secondary-button text on the current surface.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 3 px focus ring. Always visible, never removed.

tokens.name: selected-wash
tokens.usage: Ground of a selected choice card, always with the Electric border and a filled radio, never alone.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Errors and the personal-data block: text, border, glyph. 6.6:1 on white, 8.6:1 on Zed. Always with a glyph and words.

tokens.name: error-wash
tokens.usage: Ground of a highlighted personal-data match.

tokens.name: warn-ink
tokens.usage: 'Check first' and work-contact warnings. 6.6:1 on its wash.

tokens.name: warn-wash
tokens.usage: Ground of a 'Check first' notice and a warn-level personal-data match.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: The 'Checked' state of a file and similar quiet confirmations. Always with a check glyph. 6.6:1 on white.

tokens.name: tier-1
tokens.usage: Tier 1, Spark. A One's spark, number and accent; only on Zed or Graphite (6.4:1).

tokens.name: tier-2
tokens.usage: Tier 2, Glow. Only on Zed or Graphite (8.4:1).

tokens.name: tier-3
tokens.usage: Tier 3, Flame. Only on Zed or Graphite (12.2:1).

tokens.name: tier-4
tokens.usage: Tier 4, Blaze. Only on Zed or Graphite (15.9:1).

tokens.name: tier-5
tokens.usage: Tier 5, White heat. Only on Zed or Graphite (18.3:1).

tokens.name: tier-6
tokens.usage: Tier 6, Blue flame. Only on Zed or Graphite (10.6:1).

tokens.name: tier-7
tokens.usage: Tier 7, Star. Only on Zed or Graphite (7.3:1).

styles.name: display-160
styles.usage: Launch, Wall hero at 1440. Steps down to display-64 at 360 px.

styles.name: display-96
styles.usage: Brand page heroes: home band, Wall, journey.

styles.name: display-64
styles.sample: What the Ones are up to
styles.usage: Brand section heads; heroes at 360 px.

styles.name: display-44
styles.usage: Glow-up and dashboard headline; brand heads at 360 px.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: One per working screen. 30 px at 360.

styles.name: body-long
styles.sample: Every month-end the team rebuilds the same reconciliation sheet by hand.
styles.usage: What people type and read at length: canvas answers, summaries, The Ember.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The review desk looks at it within 5 working days.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Why we ask: one clear line is what gets read first.
styles.usage: Hints, meta, table secondary text. Nothing smaller on employee screens.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Buttons. 15 px on small desk buttons, 18 px on brand CTAs.

styles.name: jersey-200
styles.usage: A One's own number on their dashboard and the glow-up. Geist Mono only ever sets jersey numbers and the compounding line.

styles.name: jersey-96
styles.usage: One cards on the Wall, home and office screens.

styles.name: jersey-40
styles.usage: Leaderboard rows, console roster, email number block.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text inside a chip; between slashes.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Label to hint; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between buttons in a row; choice card gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter at 360 px; panel padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel and card padding; field to field.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutter at 1440; question to question in the canvas.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Section to section on working screens.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Before a brand band; between canvas sections.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Brand band padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Brand hero padding at 1440.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Full-bleed bands, tables, the header. Square is the default for structure.

tokens.name: radius-field
tokens.usage: Inputs, textareas, selects, checkboxes (4px). Precise: the 99% sweat.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Panels, idea and match cards, status boxes on white.

tokens.name: radius-slab
tokens.usage: Zed slabs, One cards, dialogs and sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Everything you press or that names a state: buttons, chips, stage pills. Round like the mark's zeros.

shadow.note: Elevation on white is a fill (Paper) or a line; on Zed it is lightness (Graphite, Coal). A shadow means 'this floats over the page' and nothing else.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Dialogs, the stuck side panel, the success toast, the mobile menu sheet.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Cards and panels. They sit on the page; they don't float.

duration.note: Motion timings, borrowed in shape from Astryx's motion roles (press, state change, reveal). Exits run at 75% of the entrance.

tokens.name: t-press
tokens.usage: Button press, checkbox tick.

tokens.name: t-state
tokens.usage: Hover, focus, colour change, disclosure open. Also the cap for every reduced-motion cross-fade.

tokens.name: t-reveal
tokens.usage: A result arriving: match cards, a dialog, a section opening.

tokens.name: t-scene
tokens.usage: The one deliberate moment on a brand screen: the spark rising, a One's number heating.

tokens.name: t-glow
tokens.usage: The glow-up only: the spark heating from the old tier to the new (DEC-084).

easing.note: ease-out is the expo-out curve Lenis scrolls with (1.001 - 2^-10t). ease-move is Astryx's curves.move, used for cross-fades. No bounce, no elastic.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Everything that arrives or answers a press.

tokens.name: ease-move
tokens.usage: Cross-fades, colour heat, and every reduced-motion replacement.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Exits only (dialog closing, a toast leaving).

size.note: Fixed measures the layout leans on.

tokens.name: tap
tokens.usage: Minimum height of anything you press on employee screens (44 px is the floor; 48 is the default).

tokens.name: header-h
tokens.usage: The Zed header.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Longest line of reading text.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Content width on working screens.
